m1NetIssueEditionSnapshot.interpretationEn: Historical snapshot on the merged M1 tree. External owner sign-off and merge bound that Head. The boolean does not reopen the merge; it remains a transferred technical action.

observationBoundary.silenceRuleEn: Absence of a captured packet is not protocol silence unless the observation window, correlation key and clock are declared.

timeSemantics.delayEn: During delay, clocks in C grow, variables in V are unchanged, and state invariants hold.
timeSemantics.discreteEn: A transition is enabled when its guard holds in the source state. Evaluation order: guard, updates, clock resets, outputs, then target. Outputs are instantaneous on the declared channel.
timeSemantics.raceEn: Timeout events compete with packet events without a forged priority. Simultaneous same-channel events are environment nondeterminism.
timeSemantics.endpointEn: Closed endpoints include equality. Unresolved bounds are not treated as unbounded.

scope.compositionEn: One protocol machine with two observation projections (DL, TH) sharing variables and clocks. Not two unsynchronized swimlanes.

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: UPLOAD LUI header-file name encoding uses the same HEADER-FILE object that 665-5 defines for software-part header files. The edge is limited to that shared object; it does not import 665 media-set or CRC algorithms.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: UPLOAD LUI 头文件名编码与 665-5 软件件头文件共享 HEADER-FILE 对象。边仅覆盖该对象，不引入 665 媒体集或 CRC 算法。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: LUI table field FIELD-LOAD-PART-NUMBER-NAME and 665-5 load-part-number encoding share the LOAD-PART-NUMBER object used during UPLOAD list transfer.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: LUI 表字段 FIELD-LOAD-PART-NUMBER-NAME 与 665-5 装载件号编码共享 UPLOAD 列表传输使用的 LOAD-PART-NUMBER 对象。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: 615A 5.3.2.2 requires transferring TFTP options. RFC 2347 is the option-extension mechanism named by P3 for base TFTP. The edge does not activate P3 profiled deviations or claim complete RFC-2347 conformance.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: 615A 5.3.2.2 要求传输 TFTP 选项。RFC 2347 是 P3 为基线 TFTP 点名的选项扩展机制。该边不激活 P3 裁剪偏差，也不声称完整 RFC-2347 符合性。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: Inventory of UPLOAD/INFORMATION option units (CRS-M1-00020..00023, 00074, 00075, 00081, 00083) does not name RFC 1785. P7 listings remain with unselected AFDX and do not create an active 615A edge.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: UPLOAD/INFORMATION 选项单元盘点未点名 RFC 1785。P7 列举仍随未选择的 AFDX，不产生活动 615A 边。
sourceRefinements.impactEn: TFTP option negotiation identity stays NOT-ESTABLISHED; model uses 615A option presence/absence only.
sourceRefinements.impactZh: TFTP 选项协商身份保持未建立；模型仅使用 615A 选项在场/缺席。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: No inventoried 615A UPLOAD/INFORMATION unit names the blksize option token. Default TFTP block handling remains 615A-defined, not an RFC-2348 edge.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: 已盘点的 615A UPLOAD/INFORMATION 单元未点名 blksize 选项标记。默认 TFTP 块处理仍由 615A 定义，不构成 RFC-2348 边。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: 615A exception and DLP timers are protocol parameters, not an identified RFC-2349 timeout/tsize option unit.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: 615A 异常与 DLP 定时器是协议参数，不是已识别的 RFC-2349 timeout/tsize 选项单元。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: Current Ethernet profile uses P2 for physical/data-link identity. Capability ETHERNET-PHYSICAL-LINK-SEMANTICS remains NOT-ESTABLISHED.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: 当前 Ethernet Profile 以 P2 标识物理/数据链路。ETHERNET-PHYSICAL-LINK-SEMANTICS 能力仍未建立。

sourceRefinements.rationaleEn: IEEE 802.3 (2000) is not acquired. It is a possible subordinate of P2 physical Ethernet and is not assumed to be AFDX-only without a source check. No CRS edge is created.
sourceRefinements.rationaleZh: IEEE 802.3（2000）未取得。它可能从属于 P2 物理以太网，未经来源检查不得假定仅与 AFDX 有关。不创建 CRS 边。

sourceRefinements.currentServiceImpactEn: Pins Compliant IPv4/UDP interpretation to Supplement 1 (2004-12-22). Does not claim latest-edition compliance. Independent review still required to close the edition action.
sourceRefinements.currentServiceImpactZh: 将 Compliant IPv4/UDP 解释钉在补充 1（2004-12-22）。不声称最新版符合性。关闭版次行动仍须独立评审。
sourceRefinements.deltaVsUnacquiredLaterEn: Later P3 supplements are not in the acquisition record; differences are UNKNOWN-UNCOMPARED.
sourceRefinements.deltaVsUnacquiredLaterZh: 后续 P3 补充版不在获取记录中；差异为 UNKNOWN-UNCOMPARED。

sourceRefinements.currentServiceImpactEn: Base P7 is recorded only for deferred AFDX/AID/address issues. Unselected deployment; AID future supplement remains open.
sourceRefinements.currentServiceImpactZh: P7 初版仅用于延期的 AFDX/AID/寻址问题。未选择部署；AID 未来补充版仍开放。
sourceRefinements.deltaVsUnacquiredLaterEn: Later P7 supplements including AID are not acquired.
sourceRefinements.deltaVsUnacquiredLaterZh: 含 AID 的后续 P7 补充版未取得。

networkRelationDispositions.rationaleEn: 615A 1.3 invokes P3. DD-023 selects its Compliant Network route; P3 exception tables do not replace applicable RFC behavior. Exact-edition acceptance remains an external review decision.
networkRelationDispositions.rationaleZh: 615A 1.3 引用 P3。DD-023 选择其 Compliant Network 路径；P3 例外表不替代适用 RFC 行为。精确版次接受仍由外部评审决定。

networkRelationDispositions.rationaleEn: The current 615A loader fragmentation/reassembly obligation is retained. DD-023 excludes P3 no-reassembly deviations; MTU is a network-size constraint, not an operation deadline.
networkRelationDispositions.rationaleZh: 保留当前 615A 加载器分片／重组义务。DD-023 排除 P3 不重组偏差；MTU 属于网络尺寸约束，并非操作时限。

networkRelationDispositions.rationaleEn: DL-TFTP refers back to 615A; the AFDX example using port 69 does not override 615A port 59.
networkRelationDispositions.rationaleZh: DL-TFTP 回引 615A；使用端口 69 的 AFDX 示例不覆盖 615A 端口 59。

networkRelationDispositions.rationaleEn: P3 names RFC 2347 for base TFTP options; the precise 615A port-option source unit still needs review before a direct RFC edge is emitted.
networkRelationDispositions.rationaleZh: P3 为基础 TFTP 选项列出 RFC 2347；615A 端口选项的精确来源单元仍需评审，之后才可建立直接 RFC 边。

states.summaryEn: TH has received LCI RRQ or DL has issued it
Information operation completed; may bootstrap UPLOAD; not a conformance success claim
Upload completed; integrity success blocked without ARINC 645
Transfer or protocol failure; not success

variables.note: Must remain false while ARINC 645 is open

clocks.meaningEn: Time since last TFTP packet of the current transfer
Silence clock after status carrying exception timer

events.summaryEn: DL issues TFTP RRQ for LCI
Local accept/reject evaluation; not claimed observed

transitions.noteEn: DL starts INFORMATION via LCI RRQ
TH accept; not a later success claim
Reject is terminal for this operation
LCL data; length preserved, content abstract
End session without upload; local, not a protocol success bit
Exception expiry is failure, not success
DL starts UPLOAD via LUI RRQ
Data file TFTP; CRC result interface blocked
Option transfer; unimplemented option must not fail
Missing status inside DLP window is not silence-as-success

infrastructurePremises.behaviorEn: Host IPv4/UDP service used by Compliant 615A loaders without P3 deviations: addressing, ports, fragmentation/reassembly retained from 615A, UDP datagram delivery.
infrastructurePremises.acceptanceEn: Independent review of a Project Configuration that names the host stack and the applicable RFC subset. Not a complete RFC inventory.

infrastructurePremises.behaviorEn: Only host requirements actually triggered by the IPv4/UDP path above. RFC 1123 does not replace RFC 1122.

actions.noteEn: Two source-explicit 615A→665 edges for objects the model uses. Remaining 665 items stay DATA-CONSTRAINT or DEPENDENCY-BLOCKED.
RFC-2347 option transfer edge from CRS-M1-00020; RFC-1785/2348/2349 have no active named 615A unit.
Attachment 4 equations and current-service timers are in timingCatalog. Unused analyses listed in analysisScope.excluded.
Label harmonization not performed; no locator error found that required stop.
Historical editions are conditional inputs. M1 blocksM1Approval snapshot retained; merge is not re-opened by that boolean.
Only host requirements triggered by the current IPv4/UDP path; not a substitute for RFC 1122.
Four integrity capabilities remain NOT-ESTABLISHED. Model keeps integrity interface without PASS.

analysisScope.finiteDomainEn: Control states are finite. File payloads are abstracted to length, name and direction. Symbolic timers remain symbolic.
